ITEM #5

  MINUTES
  City of La Habra Heights
  Special Meeting of the La Habra Heights Roads Advisory Committee
  June 27, 2022

Call to Order – Regular Roads Advisory Committee Meeting

Opening Ceremonies

1.  Call Meeting to Order – At 6:38 p.m., Chair Donato called the Regular Roads
  Advisory Committee meeting to order.

2.  Roll Call

Present: Chair Tony Donato, Vice Chair John Steele, and Committee Member Ross
Owen

Present via Zoom: Committee Members John Richert

Absent: None

Also Present: Assistant City Manager Rafferty Wooldridge and Public Works Specialist
Grace Andres

Also Present via Zoom: City Manager Fabiola Huerta and City Engineer Akram Hindiyeh

3.  Flag Salute

4.  Public Comment

Consent Calendar

5.  Minutes: May 25, 2022 – Regular Roads Advisory Committee Meeting

Action: Moved (Owen), seconded (Steele), and voted 5-0 to approve the May 25, 2022
Regular Roads Advisory Committee meeting minutes.

  ---------------------------------- End of Consent Calendar ----------------------------------

SPECIAL ROADS ADVISORY COMMITTEE MEETING  1  JUNE 27, 2022
MINUTES
 Administrative Items

6.  Verbal Updates

  •  Pavement Management Plan
  •  Fiscal Year 2020-21 Street Improvement Project – Zone 1 West Road/Las
  Palomas Drive
  •  Fiscal Year 2021-22 Street Improvement Project – Zone 2 Encanada
  Drive/Subtropic Drive
  •  Fiscal Year 2022-23 Street Improvement Project – Zone 4 Hacienda Road/
  East Road
  •  Hacienda Road Drainage Project
  •  Highway Street Improvement Program (HSIP) Projects: Hacienda
  Road/Avocado Crest Road Traffic Signal and Guardrail Replacement

  •  Action: The Roads Advisory Committee recommended that the City Council
  award the Pavement Management Plan Update project to Bucknam
  Infrastructure Group, Inc.

  •  Action: Staff provided a verbal update about the Fiscal Year 2020-21 Street
  Improvement Project – Zone 1 West Road/Las Palomas Drive, and Fiscal Year
  2021-22 Street Improvement Project – Zone 2 Encanada Drive/Subtropic
  Drive.

  •  Action: The Roads Advisory Committee recommended that Hacienda Road
  be separated from the remaining streets in the Fiscal Year 2022-23 Street
  Improvement Project – Zone 4 Hacienda Road/East Road to coordinate the
  work with the Hacienda Road/Avocado Crest Road Traffic Signal project.

  •  Action: Staff provided a verbal update about the Hacienda Road Drainage
  Project, and Highway Street Improvement Program (HSIP) Projects: Hacienda
  Road/Avocado Crest Road Traffic Signal and Guardrail Replacement.

  -------------------------------- End of Administrative Items --------------------------------

7.  Public Comments on Matters Not on the Agenda

Adjourn Meeting – At 7:51 p.m., Chair Donato adjourned the meeting.

Submitted for Committee Approval:

________________________________
Fabiola Huerta, City Clerk

SPECIAL ROADS ADVISORY COMMITTEE MEETING  2  JUNE 27, 2022
MINUTES
